for a Quality of 7 to 9 the copying Ease Factor is 12, and for a Quality of 10 or more the Ease Factor is 15

related.text: Covenants p.97 The First Furrow Guides the Second

entries.title: Magically Copying an Entire Book
entries.summary: Gives the time a mundane scribe needs to copy a tractatus, summa or Bible, and explains that copying a whole book in one casting needs a very hard Finesse roll, so copying page by page is compared on a table of the caster's Finesse Total against the Quality retained.
quotes: would require an Intelligence + Finesse roll against an Ease Factor of 15, minimum
compare the Finesse Total (Intelligence + Finesse) of the caster on the nearby table to determine how much Quality is retained from the original book

entries.title: Quality Remaining After Copying
entries.summary: A table showing, for a given Finesse Total, how many pages are spoiled when a book is copied page by page with magic and how far the Quality of the copy falls below the original, with adjustments for easier or harder books.
quotes: This table assumes an Ease Factor of 12 (i.e. Quality 7 to 9), a simple die roll, and no proofreading.
For books requiring Finesse rolls of Ease Factor 9, add 3 to the Finesse Total; and subtract 3 for books requiring Finesse rolls of Ease Factor 15.

entries.title: Resonances and Binding of Copied Books
entries.summary: A book copied with magic loses any resonant materials or aura clarification of the original, though a new binding can add similar benefits; unbound books are easily damaged and cannot have resonances.
quotes: If such techniques have been used in the production of a book that is then copied with magic, the benefits of such resonances are lost.

entries.title: Proofreading Copies
entries.summary: Intellego Imaginem can compare a copy with its original to find differing places, though a person who understands the text must still check them; proofreading with such a device is far faster than writing.
quotes: a text that would normally take a season to write can be proofread and corrected in a week with unlimited uses of this spell

entries.title: Copying Laboratory Texts with Magic
entries.summary: Laboratory Texts can be copied magically but must be copied exactly: failed pages must be repeated and one botched page ruins the whole text, so the Finesse Total needed for a month's or a season's worth of text is higher than for ordinary books.
quotes: a single botched page corrupts the entire Laboratory Text
120 levels in a month, and 360 levels in a season
a Finesse Total of 14 or more to copy a season's worth in the same manner

entries.title: Optional Rule: Hazardous Laboratory Texts
entries.summary: An optional rule in which errors in a magically copied Laboratory Text do not make it useless but add extra Experimentation rolls, with a risk modifier based on how many pages were spoiled, to the season of work that uses it.
quotes: the magus must make an extra roll on the Experimentation Table
then the users of the second generation copy must make two extra Experimentation rolls

entries.title: Optional Rule: No Magical Copying of Laboratory Texts
entries.summary: An optional ruling that Laboratory Texts are too sensitive to scribal error to be copied with Rego craft magic, so each must be handwritten and remains valuable.
quotes: Laboratory Texts are too sensitive to scribal errors to be copied with Rego craft magic

entries.title: Optional Rule: Limits on Instant Transportation
entries.summary: An optional way to limit instant transportation: the traveller moves through every point between origin and destination, so needs an unobstructed path, and is stopped at the nearest barrier such as a closed door or shackles.
quotes: a character must have an unobstructed path between the two locations to use such spells

related.text: ArM5 p.134 Gift of Frog's Legs

entries.title: New Guidelines for Instant Transportation
entries.summary: New spell guidelines for instantly transporting animals, liquids, plants, fire and non-living objects short distances, with extra magnitudes to extend the distance up to travelling to an Arcane Connection.
quotes: In all cases, add 1 magnitude to increase the distance to 50 paces, 2 magnitudes for 500 paces, 3 magnitudes for 1 league, 4 magnitudes for seven leagues, and 5 magnitudes to a place for which you have an Arcane Connection.
Transport a non-living object instantly up to 5 paces.

entries.title: Instant Transportation and Requisites
entries.summary: Discusses whether instant transportation needs casting requisites: Rego Corpus moves what the body wears and carries, but a heavy burden or mixed materials justify a requisite, and the primary Form comes from the highest base level.
quotes: any Burden which causes an Encumbrance of 3 or more should require a requisite appropriate to the material comprising the majority of the weight

entries.title: Shape and Material Bonuses for Transport Effects
entries.summary: Lists Shape and Material bonuses that suit magical transport effects invested in devices (doorways, halls, opal).
quotes: doorways (+5 magical transportation) or halls (+3 magical transportation), or incorporate opal (+4 travel)
entries.section: Travel in the Blink of an Eye

entries.title: Flying and Fast Travel Spells
entries.summary: Example flight and fast-travel effects that set out how speed, Finesse rolls to change direction, and Load limits work for a flying caster, rug, boat or wind form, including how a gale form can knock objects over.
quotes: this is reduced by one mile an hour for every point of Load he carries
Ease Factor 12 at moderate speed, Ease Factor 15 at maximum speed of forty miles an hour

entries.title: Hermes' Portal and Mercere's Portals Compared
entries.summary: Compares the Hermes' Portal ritual and the permanent Mercere's Portals with instant-transportation devices: portals need a pair of high-level castings or enchantments and cannot be redirected, but they carry any object and give no Warping to the traveller.
quotes: A Hermes' Portal requires two casters (or groups using Wizard's Communion) who can cast a 75th level Ritual spell, and it lasts just a year.
still constitute a 65th level enchantment

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages pp.80, 100-101

entries.title: Warping from Repeated Instant Transportation
entries.summary: Transportation effects of high level give a Warping point at every casting; after several castings the target gains a Minor Flaw, again after more, and after a very large number of transits a Minor Virtue. Inanimate objects are warped too, and there are no firm rules for what that does.
quotes: if a person, animal, or object is affected 5 times or more, it will suffer a Minor Flaw (ArM5, page 168), and another after 15 castings
Should one target experience 75 or more transits, it also accumulates a Minor Virtue.

entries.title: Storage and Loss of Magically-Created Grain
entries.summary: Magically created grain spoils like ordinary grain: a yearly percentage is lost to rot and vermin, more without precautions, while each inhabitant point consumes a fixed number of bushels a year; a worked example shows how long a store lasts.
quotes: A peasant in Mythic Europe requires about 24 bushels of grain each year to support his nutritional needs.
the loss rate can be 5 to 10 per cent

entries.title: Magical Mechanical Power
entries.summary: An example enchantment that does the work of a draft animal by turning an axle, with the rule that each added magnitude multiplies its power output.
quotes: the Hermetic Generans can do as much work as a person or animal with a Strength of +5 (approximately one horse-power)
each magnitude added to the effect increases the power output ten-fold

entries.title: Magical Devices in Warfare
entries.summary: Practical limits on using enchanted devices in battle: high-level effects are costly, carrying and activating items mid-fight is dangerous, a Group target needs a clearly separated group so crowds rarely qualify, and Aegis-protected covenants are immune to breaching devices.
quotes: a group must be clearly separated from others of its kind (ArM5, page 113)
devices like the Instant Breach are useless against covenants protected by an Aegis of the Hearth

entries.title: Magical Medicine and Disease Recovery
entries.summary: Explains how a bonus to Disease Recovery rolls from a healing device changes the odds of a severe disease worsening or improving, and that ritual cures cannot be put into enchanted items.
quotes: with a +6 bonus to Disease Recovery rolls he has an even chance of improving, and has only a one in a hundred chance of getting worse

entries.title: Enchantments are Arcane Connections
entries.summary: An enchanted item is an Arcane Connection to its maker for a time that depends on the kind of enchantment, an optional rule makes charged items connections for a shorter time, and a Vim spell can shorten a connection's duration before an item is sold.
quotes: A lesser enchantment is an Arcane Connection to its creator that persists for weeks after creation, and invested items last years.
As an option, a saga might decide that charged items remain Arcane Connections for days.

entries.title: Inanis (Optional Magical Pollution)
entries.summary: An optional rule for magical pollution: residue left when vis is imbued into objects can be gathered into pawns of inanis, which cancel magical effects of limited magnitude within a radius over time and drain Might from supernatural creatures that linger in its area.
quotes: One pawn of inanis takes one round to stop a first magnitude magical effect from working within one pace.
Supernatural creatures with a Might less than or equal to (5 x pawns) of inanis lose one Might for every season they spend within its area of effect.
entries.section: Magic as an Agent of Social Change

entries.title: Crafters of Wondrous Items
entries.summary: Characters with a Touched by (Realm) Virtue can make enchanted items without vis and with workshop help, but only in two Forms, only for one named user, and with strict limits on Range, Duration and Target and no Penetration.
quotes: the effect is limited to Range: Personal or Touch, the Duration must be Sun or less, and the Target must be Individual
These devices cannot Penetrate any Magic Resistance.
entries.section: Magic as an Agent of Social Change

entries.title: The Rusticani and Craft Magic
entries.requires: Virtue: Craft Magic (Rusticani, House Ex Miscellanea)
entries.summary: Craft Magic lets a hedge wizard turn any magic he knows into a charged item or lesser enchantment; it needs vis already in the crafted object but takes only as long as making the mundane object.
quotes: the Craft Magic Major Supernatural Virtue permits its possessor to enchant any other magic he knows or Virtue he possesses into a charged item or lesser enchantment
entries.section: Magic as an Agent of Social Change

entries.title: Learned Magicians as Inventors
entries.summary: Learned magicians can produce only the equivalent of charged items in the laboratory, but make chartae in hours or days rather than a season, so their inventions are limited to small local benefits.
quotes: While their laboratory activities can only produce the equivalent of charged items, their production of chartae in particular is very swift, taking a matter of hours or days rather than a season.
entries.section: Magic as an Agent of Social Change

groups.title: Spell guidelines from other books
groups.intro: New guidelines, Finesse, species and memory, and the finer points of the Forms from the supplements.

entries.title: The Lyceum on Substance and Categories
entries.summary: Goes through Aristotle's ten categories and says which of them Hermetic Techniques currently affect, which are indirect, and which would need a new Technique or a breakthrough. Useful guidance when adjudicating or inventing unusual effects.
quotes: Changes in continuous quantity are under the control of Muto; such changes are rarely natural.

entries.title: Causality and Spell Design
entries.summary: Uses Aristotelian causes to decide which Hermetic Form a spell that imitates a natural phenomenon belongs to: the target is the material cause and magic replaces the efficient cause.
quotes: The target of Hermetic magic is always the material cause of the spell, and so the correct Hermetic Form can be determined by considering that which is changed.

entries.title: Consequences of Generation and Destruction (Creo and Perdo)
entries.summary: Explains what Creo can and cannot create (only things that can exist as natural forms, healing as restoring a form) and why Perdo dissolves substance rather than improving it.
quotes: Further, Creo magic cannot cause a cat to grow wings, because wings are not part of the form of a cat, but it can restore a leg which has been removed.
Perdo magic dissolves substances, not matter.

entries.title: Consequences of Alteration (Rego and Muto)
entries.summary: Distinguishes natural alteration, which is handled by Rego, from Muto, which changes categories of quality without changing substance. Includes the implications for shapechanging and Bjornaer heartbeasts.
quotes: Alteration does not necessarily fall under the Hermetic Technique of Muto; in fact, most alteration is in terms of natural changes, and is the purview of Rego spells.

entries.title: Consequences of Growth and Diminution (Creo and Muto)
entries.summary: Says growth is best simulated with Creo, while Muto growth changes the category of quantity and cannot be permanent.
quotes: Growth is most easily simulated with magic by creating more substance directly by informing new matter to account for the change in size, and thus is an exercise of the Technique of Creo.

entries.title: Consequences of Motion (Rego, Penetration and Aiming)
entries.summary: Explains why thrown missiles do no extra damage for speed, why objects guided by Rego are affected by Magic Resistance, and the two ways a Rego spell can avoid needing Penetration, each of which requires an Aiming roll.
quotes: This method requires an Aiming roll to ensure the object is released in the right position.

related.text: Houses of Hermes: Societates, House Flambeau

entries.title: Generating Worms (Rego Animal vermin)
entries.summary: Describes how Rego Animal spells can produce vermin from suitable raw substrate, how many creatures a Target: Group spell yields, and the cap on creatures per standard individual of the substrate.
quotes: a Target: Group spell is capable of producing a mass of animals equal to 10 standard targets (animals of Size +1)
can produce a maximum of 1000 creatures regardless of their size

entries.title: New Rego Animal Guideline (vermin)
entries.summary: New Rego Animal spell guideline for causing vermin to generate spontaneously, with a note on when a requisite for the substrate is needed.
quotes: Cause vermin to spontaneously generate in appropriate matter, such as flesh, plants, soil, or water.

entries.title: The Human Mind and the five inner wits
entries.summary: Describes the five inner wits (common sense, imagination, cognition, estimation, memory) and the soul's reason and intellect. This is the model that the extended Mentem guidelines in this chapter are built on.
quotes: The functions of the sensitive faculty — collectively called the inner wits — are the five components of the mind.

entries.title: The Hermetic Art of Mentem
entries.summary: Explains how the existing Mentem spell guidelines map onto the five inner wits, which are easier to affect, and that Hermetic magic cannot touch reason or intellect directly.
quotes: Broadly speaking, an existing guideline that mentions emotions is operating on the estimation, and a guideline that mentions thoughts is operating on the imagination.

related.text: The Mysteries Revised Edition pp.102-113 (dream spells)

entries.title: Creo Mentem Guidelines (inner wits)
entries.summary: Extends the Creo Mentem guidelines to show which inner wit each affects, including hallucinations in the common sense, planted thoughts and emotions, and dreams or plans in cognition.
quotes: Additional species cost one magnitude each

entries.title: Intellego Mentem Guidelines (inner wits)
entries.summary: Extends the Intellego Mentem guidelines to read emotions, senses, surface thoughts, memories, short-term plans, and dreams through the relevant wit.
quotes: interrogates the imagination, and can also be used to read the entire common sense

entries.title: Muto Mentem Guidelines (inner wits)
entries.summary: Extends the Muto Mentem guidelines so changes to memories, emotions and rewriting a mind can alter imagination, estimation, common sense and cognition.
quotes: can rewrite any of the five wits

entries.title: Perdo Mentem Guidelines (inner wits)
entries.summary: Extends the Perdo Mentem guidelines to the five wits, noting that damage to wits other than memory heals naturally.
quotes: Unlike memories, destroyed aspects of the imagination, cognition, common sense, and estimation naturally restore themselves.

entries.title: Rego Mentem Guidelines (inner wits)
entries.summary: Extends the Rego Mentem guidelines to control emotions, thoughts, dream subject and content, and complex commands through the relevant wit.
quotes: directly controls the cognition, setting the target's goals towards that determined by the caster.

entries.title: Magic Affecting Conscience (removing a demon's Obsession)
entries.summary: Sparking a target's conscience with Creo Mentem can strip a demon's Obsession Trait but cannot change existing Personality Traits. Includes the new level 10 Creo Mentem guideline for it.
quotes: Level 10: Spark a twinge of conscience in an intelligent being's mind, overriding the temporary obsession of a demon.

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal pp.31-32 (obsession power)

entries.title: Creo Aquam Guidelines
entries.summary: New Creo Aquam guideline for creating ice in natural shapes.
quotes: Create ice in a natural shape, such as a floe or icicle.

entries.title: Muto Auram Guidelines
entries.summary: New Muto Auram guidelines for turning a gas into a harmful gas that causes a Light or Medium Wound.
quotes: Transform a gas into a harmful gas causing a Light Wound (Stamina roll against Ease Factor 6 to resist)

entries.title: Perdo Terram Guidelines
entries.summary: New Perdo Terram guideline for destroying a single aspect of dirt.
quotes: Destroy one aspect of dirt, such as its weight or its cohesiveness

entries.title: Rego Terram Guidelines
entries.summary: New Rego Terram guidelines for throwing stone projectiles, with damage limited by spell level.
quotes: Hurl a stone projectile with enough force to do +5 damage (range increment of 20 paces)

entries.title: Small Effects and High Penetration Bonuses (Subtle, Public and Wilderness Spells)
entries.summary: Describes the three categories of spells urban magi choose (subtle, public and wilderness), how Dominion and casting-style penalties apply to each, and why low-level subtle spells have good Penetration.
quotes: Most cities have a Divine aura of 3, which means that spellcasting rolls are penalized by –9.

related.text: ArM5 p.145 Aura of Ennobled Presence
ArM5 p.151 The Call to Slumber

entries.title: Invocation of the Civic Patron
entries.summary: Notes that a character may ask a city's patron saint for a miracle allowing virtuous magic to ignore Dominion penalties for a scene or story.
quotes: the penalties the character suffers due to the Realm Interaction Chart are reduced to zero

entries.title: Spell Mastery for Urban Characters
entries.summary: Points out which Spell Mastery abilities help urban magi and mentions a form of mastery that lets formulaic spells use ceremonial casting bonuses without any initiation.

entries.title: Finesse in Artistic Magic
entries.summary: Introduces using Finesse to add detail to created objects and illusions that magic otherwise fills in from the Form, and notes that the product carries the magus's sigil.

entries.title: Creating Objects with Creo Magic
entries.summary: Explains that Creo makes a functional natural object automatically, with an optional Intelligence + Finesse roll to add detail, and that artificial objects need the same Finesse as Rego.
quotes: The magus may use an Intelligence + Finesse roll to add detail, making the creation particularly beautiful or suited to a task.

entries.title: Crafting Objects with Rego Magic
entries.summary: Gives the Finesse Ease Factor for doing with Rego what a mundane artist could do with tools, adjusted by how long the mundane work would take.
quotes: The Finesse roll required is three more than the Ease Factor the mundane craftsman would have to make.
To do what a mundane artist could do in a season adds +6 to the Ease Factor.

entries.title: Flourishes
entries.summary: Lets artistic magi vary their sigil with cosmetic flourishes by concentrating, at a cost to the Finesse roll's Ease Factor.
quotes: Attempting to create a flourish adds 3 to the Ease Factor for the spell's Intelligence + Finesse roll.

entries.title: Crafting Items Using Rego Magic (Spell Levels by Material)
entries.summary: A table of base spell levels for Rego spells that make Individual-size items from raw materials at Personal Range and Momentary Duration.
quotes: These levels are correct for all spells that make items of Individual size, at Personal Range, with Momentary Duration.

entries.title: Ease Factors for Creating and Crafting Objects
entries.summary: A table of Finesse Ease Factors by artistic task difficulty, with notes on the included magic adjustment and when Creo magic needs a roll.
quotes: A character using Creo magic need not roll Finesse unless he desires the finished product to be of a quality higher than that represented by an Ease Factor of 9 on the following table.

entries.title: Species
entries.summary: Describes the four kinds of species (iconic, echoic, haptic, olfactory and gustative) that Imaginem magic manipulates and which sense each one reaches.

entries.title: Level of Succes for Illusions
entries.summary: A scale of Finesse results that says how much control a magus has over the details of an illusion, including how convincing a copy of a particular person is.
quotes: The magus makes either a Perception + Finesse roll to copy something, or an Intelligence + Finesse roll to create an image without a model

entries.title: Finesse Bonuses and Penalties for Familiarity
entries.summary: Lists the modifiers to the Finesse roll for creating, crafting or simulating objects, depending on how familiar the magus is with the simile of the object.
quotes: The Finesse roll for using magic to create, craft, or simulate objects is adjusted by familiarity with the simile in the following ways.

entries.title: Species Magic: New Targets for Species
entries.summary: Explains how Muto spells treat species as a slightly unnatural substance requiring an Imaginem requisite, and defines the Individual, Part and Group Targets used for species, with an example spell.
quotes: The following Targets are used for species, supplementing those found in the core rulebook.

entries.title: Additional, Minor Senses
entries.summary: Describes proprioception, balance and pain as internal senses that Mentem can target and Corpus can attack, and says how they count for base spell levels.
quotes: Pain, proprioception and balance are treated as mental capabilities with regard to base levels for spellcasting given in the core rulebook.

entries.title: Mimicry: Making Illusionary Objects
entries.summary: Describes mimicry, the standard Hermetic illusion that sheds natural, non-magical species of a created object, needing little Finesse and not being resisted by the Parma Magica.
quotes: Mimics are not resisted by the Parma Magica, because their species are not magical.

entries.title: Transparency (Destroying Species Before They Reach a Viewer)
entries.summary: Rules for illusions of transparency that hide an object from one viewer: the base level, the Individual Target used, the Perception + Finesse roll and a table of Ease Factor modifiers by size of the hidden object.
quotes: Casting an illusion of transparency requires a Perception + Finesse roll against an Ease Factor of 6.
Transparencies use the Individual Target to represent the stream of species between the hidden object and observer.

entries.title: Macrotures: Illusions of Proximity to the Organ of Perception
entries.summary: Describes macrotures, images magnified beyond what the eye can do by forcing species to strike the eye less concentrated, and the uses magi find for them.
quotes: These are already discussed in the Intellego Imaginem guidelines in ArM5 (base level 3).

entries.title: Synaesthesia: Switching Organs of Perception
entries.summary: Explains synaesthetic illusions that alter species so a stronger sense perceives them, the limit that external-sense species changed into internal-sense ones have no effect, and the base level for such transformations.
quotes: Spells that transform the species that trigger one sense into those that trigger another have a base level of 2.

entries.title: Anamorphs
entries.summary: Rules for shapeless illusions that exploit the viewer's tendency to fill in details: a Perception + Awareness roll for the victim against a computed Ease Factor, a table of outcomes by margin, the base level, and the penalty for fooling extra senses.
quotes: Victim's Perception Ease Factor: die + value of dominant, active Personality Trait + caster's Perception + caster's Finesse
As images that affect a single sense, they have a base level of 1.

entries.title: Anamorph Example
entries.summary: A worked example of the anamorph rules showing how the victim's Ease Factor is totalled and how the guard's Perception + Awareness result is read.

entries.title: Created Emotional Bias
entries.summary: Guidelines for spells that cloud a mind with emotion as an artificial Personality Trait, how extreme and milder emotions are resisted, and base levels for directed, undirected and class-directed emotions.
quotes: Spells that create extreme emotions can be resisted with a roll of any opposed Personality Trait against an Ease Factor of 9.
Spells that create milder emotions are resisted by a roll against an Ease Factor of (4 + the score of the artificial Personality Trait)

related.text: ArM5 p.148 Panic of the Trembling Heart

entries.title: Diminished Mental Capability
entries.summary: Extends the Perdo Mentem guideline for destroying a mental capacity with a list of other capacities a spell can inhibit.
quotes: This has a base level of 4, noted on page 150 of ArM5.

related.text: ArM5 p.150 Trust of Childlike Faith

entries.title: Miniatures: Tricks Using Perspective
entries.summary: Rules for miniatures, small illusions that send species in one direction to fake a larger scene or fool a single viewer: the extra magnitude, the Perception + Finesse roll, and a table of Ease Factor modifiers.
quotes: Most miniatures are one magnitude higher than the base level given by the table on page 144 of ArM5.
A miniature's caster must make a Perception + Finesse roll against an Ease Factor of 9 to successfully create the illusion.

entries.title: States of Consciousness
entries.summary: Guideline for Rego Mentem spells that alter a target's mental state, with a list of further states (animalist, anaesthetic, daydreaming, dreaming, self-aware, somnambulistic, unconscious) that can be targeted like the core examples.
quotes: These spells have a base level of 4 (ArM5, page 151).

entries.title: Altering Thoughts
entries.summary: Explains that Mentem magic can target thoughts or the capacity to think, and that changing or destroying thoughts uses the same base levels as for memories.
quotes: It is also possible to change and destroy thoughts, using the same base levels as for memories.

related.text: ArM5 p.150 Tip of the Tongue

entries.title: Memory
entries.summary: Introduces inscribed, procedural and episodic memories and what Hermetic magic can and cannot do with each, including that Abilities cannot be created by magic and episodic memories may give facts or a Lore success.
quotes: The core rulebook assigns a base level of 5 to spells that create a single memory.

entries.title: Procedural Memories
entries.summary: Procedural memories are the sequences behind physical Abilities used without thought; Hermetic magic can target but not create them, and rare inherited procedural memory is modelled with Virtues.
quotes: Hermetic magic may target procedural memories, but cannot create them.

entries.title: Episodic Memories
entries.summary: Describes episodic memories and gives the Intelligence + Finesse roll that sets how detailed and convincing a created episodic memory is, with results from botch to success by 9 or more.
quotes: The level of detail in an episodic memory is dependent on an Intelligence + Finesse roll against an Ease Factor of 6.

entries.title: The Memorization of Created Knowledge
entries.summary: Explains how a target can retain a created thought or memory after the spell expires by using it to build episodic memories, and the time that takes and its imprecision.
quotes: This is not an effective teaching aid, because it requires an hour of work for each image or significant cluster of facts to fix itself in memory.

entries.title: Other Tricks of Memory (Storage and Inclinations)
entries.summary: Gives spell guidelines for turning a memory or emotion into a solid object and for Rego Mentem inclinations such as belief or lack of interest.
quotes: The base level of this is 5, and it requires a Requisite for the final form of the memory.

entries.title: New Corpus Guidelines
entries.summary: A new Creo Corpus spell guideline for improving all of a target's wounds at once.
quotes: Level 25: Improve all wounds by one level of severity.

entries.title: Wards and Penetration
entries.summary: Explains that Hermetic warding spells must penetrate Magic Resistance, why high-level wards are impractical, and why Arcane Connections generally cannot boost Penetration for ward spells.
quotes: these wards must penetrate Magic Resistance to have their effect

entries.title: Ward guidelines for every Form
entries.summary: Spell guidelines for wards in each Form, all at Touch range, Ring duration and Circle target. Used to set levels for Hermetic ward spells and for the Warding Ability.
quotes: All of them are presented at Range Touch, Duration Ring, and Target: Circle
Ward against human beings. (Touch, Ring, Circle)

gated.title: Supernatural Abilities
gated.intro: Second Sight, Magic Sensitivity and the other Supernatural Abilities, and what each does.

entries.title: Supernatural Abilities as Virtues
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea or storyguide design
entries.summary: Introduces the system for designing a new Major Supernatural Virtue to be the mainstay of a tradition's magic, usable for player magi Ex Miscellanea and for non-player characters.
quotes: This section provides guidance on how a troupe can design a new Major Supernatural Virtue to be the mainstay of the magic of a tradition in House

entries.title: Using a Supernatural Ability: casting and Penetration
entries.summary: How a Supernatural Ability is used: the storyguide sets an Ease Factor, the player rolls a Characteristic plus the Ability, penetration and equivalent spell level are worked out, and raw vis can boost the total.
quotes: Casting Total: Characteristic + Ability + aura modifier + die roll
Penetration Total: Casting Total + Penetration Bonus – Ease Factor
Equivalent Spell Level: 5 x Ability

entries.title: Accelerated Abilities
entries.summary: Introduces Accelerated Abilities, Supernatural Abilities that advance on the Art experience scale and are compared with high Ease Factors such as Mights or spell levels, and lists the few ways they differ from standard Abilities.
quotes: The only other difference between a Supernatural Accelerated Ability and a Supernatural Ability is that the equivalent spell level for an Accelerated Ability is equal to the Casting Total, not (Ability x 5).

entries.title: Designing a Supernatural Ability
entries.requires: House Ex Miscellanea or storyguide design
entries.summary: How to design a Major Supernatural Ability: describe its effect by Range, Duration, Target and base guideline, fix three parameters and let one vary with the Ability score or the Ease Factor achieved, and specify its non-Hermetic invocation.
quotes: All Supernatural Abilities designed by these rules are Major Supernatural Virtues.
All Supernatural Abilities fix three of these parameters as unchangeable, and allow one to vary according to either the score in the Ability or the Ease Factor achieved by the Casting Total.

entries.title: Favored Abilities
entries.summary: Defines Favored Abilities, a group of Supernatural Abilities that do not penalize each other's Source Quality for learning, and states which Abilities are favored for magi Ex Miscellanea.
quotes: Magi Ex Miscellanea treat the Hermetic Arts and the Supernatural Ability of their tradition as Favored Abilities.

entries.title: Animal Ken
entries.summary: Lets the character communicate with animals, using their score as if it were skill in a language the animal speaks fluently.
quotes: Treat your score in Animal Ken as your score in a language that the animal speaks fluently in order to determine how well you can communicate

entries.title: Corpse Magic
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to temporarily animate or question a suitable corpse, using a Casting Total and a Commanding roll compared against Ease Factors.
quotes: Communication + Corpse Magic + Aura modifier + stress die
Communication + Leadership + stress die

entries.title: Corpse Magic Ease Factor Outcome
entries.summary: Table of what Corpse Magic achieves at each Ease Factor, including speaking to, animating and commanding corpses and the Ease Factors for commands.
quotes: Single word commands have an Ease Factor of 6, simple questions or commands require a 9, and more complex instructions or questions need a 12 or more.

entries.title: Crafter's Healing
entries.summary: Supernatural healing of wounds one level at a time at the cost of a Long-Term Fatigue level, using a roll against the Wound Recovery improvement Ease Factor, with Warping for the recipient.
quotes: Make a Presence + Crafter's Healing + stress die roll against an Ease Factor equal to the Improvement Ease Factor determined by the Wound Recovery Table

entries.title: Curse-Throwing
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability that moves diseases, curses and harmful effects from a sufferer to another recipient through a ritual, with a Casting Total against Ease Factors for the curse and modifiers for the recipient's link.
quotes: Presence + Curse-Throwing + Aura + stress die
PENETRATION TOTAL: Casting Total – Ease Factor + Penetration Bonus

entries.title: Dowsing
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to locate nearby things with a dowsing rod, with search time depending on area and Ease Factor depending on rarity and distance.
quotes: To find something common, like water, within 25 paces requires a Perception + Dowsing of 9+.

entries.title: Embitterment
entries.requires: the Embitterment Virtue, or a tradition that teaches it
entries.summary: You can cause one person to hate another. This Ability is described in the Hermetic Magic chapter, page [245](#embitterment-2).

entries.title: Enchanting (Ability)
entries.summary: Supernatural performance Ability that sways emotions; roll Communication plus the Ability against Ease Factors for different effects, with Magic Resistance and botch rules.
quotes: An Ease Factor of 9 will calm the upset, 12 will win someone's love, 15 will incite a riot, and a 24 might win back a soul from the Prince of Darkness.

entries.title: Entrancement
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to command a person by eye contact, resolved against the target's Stamina roll with a bonus to the victim depending on how objectionable the command is.
quotes: Roll Presence + Entrancement against the target's Stamina roll.

entries.title: Font of Knowledge
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability letting a creature try a task using an untrained Ability, with an Ease Factor that rises with the number of uses in a day.
quotes: Intelligence + Font of Knowledge + stress die

entries.title: Hex
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to bring ruin on enemies by eye contact, occult signs or an Arcane Connection, with the chosen delay affecting potency.
quotes: There are three ways for her to activate this power

versions.title: Hex (Infernal)
versions.summary: Rules for cursing an enemy: three ways to activate the Power, a time frame whose delay modifier affects the roll, a Hex total compared to an Ease Factor table of severities, botch results, and how hexes are removed.
quotes: Hex: stress die + Intelligence + Hex + aura bonus + modifiers
roll Intelligence + Hex + aura bonus + delay modifier
Treat the hex as having a spell level equal to the number of botch dice it approximates multiplied by 10

entries.title: Hex Delay Modifiers and Roll
entries.summary: Delay modifiers table and Hex roll, including botch consequences, how hexes are removed, and treating a hex as a spell level when dispelling it.
quotes: Stress Die + Intelligence + Hex + Aura Bonus + Modifiers
Treat the hex as having a spell level equal to the number of botch dice it approximates, multiplied by 10

entries.title: Hex Effects
entries.summary: Chart of Hex Ease Factors by severity, each comparable to a number of botch dice, with example effects.
quotes: Minor (1 botch)
Terminal (5 botches)

entries.title: Induction
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to create illusions only the target perceives; Ease Factors rise with the risk the victim takes by believing the illusion, with roll modifiers, repeat attempts and rules for whether the victim realizes magic was used.
quotes: Attempts at induction require a die roll of Communication + Induction.
A victim of induction realizes afterwards that they have been affected by magic if the roll above does not exceed the Ease Factor by (6-1 per factor from the list below).

entries.title: Entrancement and Induction
entries.summary: Explains how Entrancement and Induction differ and how a character with both can use each to support the other.
quotes: Entrancement takes control of a character's will, and dictates their actions, but does not affect what they believe or experience.

entries.title: Magic Sensitivity
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to sense the magical nature of places, items, spells and creatures, which lowers Magic Resistance and uses a roll against storyguide-set Ease Factors with guidelines for each target.
quotes: simply roll a simple die + Perception + Magic Sensitivity
Detecting a Magic aura would normally have an Ease Factor equal to 12 – aura level

entries.title: Persona
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to assume different identities, changing appearance fully while keeping Characteristics, with one identity per point and a roll to change.
quotes: a roll of Stamina + Persona against an Ease Factor of 9
The character gains one identity for every point he has in the Persona Ability.

entries.title: Premonitions
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to sense approaching danger, rolled against an Ease Factor that depends on how imminent and serious the danger is.
quotes: Roll Perception + Premonitions against an Ease Factor depending on the situation.

entries.title: Second Sight
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to see through illusory concealment and naturally invisible things, with Ease Factors based on the magnitude of the concealing effect or fixed for invisible things.
quotes: All Second Sight rolls are Perception + Second Sight, and they are almost always simple rolls.
The Ease Factor to see through illusionary concealment is normally equal to 6 + the magnitude of the might of the creature responsible for the effect, or 6 + the magnitude of a Hermetic spell.

entries.title: Sense Holiness and Unholiness
entries.summary: Divine Supernatural Ability to feel good and evil, with different Ease Factors for an area, a person or object, a demon and a hidden angel.
quotes: A Perception + Sense Holiness and Unholiness roll against an Ease Factor of 9 lets you sense holiness or unholiness in a general area; against an Ease Factor of 15, in a person or object.

entries.title: Sense Passions
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to sense emotions and Personality Traits in beings and the tarnish or temper of auras, with a limited ability to recognize spirits and holy or unholy presences.
quotes: Stress Die + Perception + Sense Passions + Aura

related.text: Realms of Power: The Infernal, page 13
Realms of Power: The Divine Revised Edition, page 38

entries.title: Shapeshifter
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to take the shape of a mundane animal within a size range, with a Stamina roll to change and one shape known per point.
quotes: a roll of Stamina + Shapeshifter against an Ease Factor of 9
You have a limited repertoire of shapes, one for every point you have in the Shapeshift ability.

entries.title: Summon Animals
entries.requires: the Summon Animals Virtue, or a tradition that teaches it
entries.summary: You can summon animals. This Ability is described in the Hermetic Magic chapter, on page [243](#summon-animals-2).

entries.title: Whistle Up The Wind
entries.requires: the Whistle Up The Wind Virtue, or a tradition that teaches it
entries.summary: You can create wind by whistling. This Ability is described in the Hermetic Magic chapter, on page 246.

entries.title: Wilderness Sense
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability to determine direction, weather, hazards or resources in the wild with one piece of information per roll.
quotes: A Perception + Wilderness Sense roll against an Ease Factor of 9 lets you determine the direction of north, the upcoming weather, or the presence of natural hazards or resources.

entries.title: Blessing
entries.requires: the Blessing Virtue, or a tradition that teaches it
entries.summary: You bring about beneficial or protective effects associated with the divine (see Miraculous Effects). *

entries.title: Cursing
entries.requires: the Cursing Virtue, or a tradition that teaches it
entries.summary: You can bring about negative effects associated with God's wrath (see Miraculous Effects). *

entries.title: Holy Magic
entries.requires: the Holy Magic Virtue, or a tradition that teaches it
entries.summary: You have translated your Hermetic Arts into a form of magic that is compatible with the Dominion and holy powers. *

entries.title: Intervention
entries.requires: the Intervention Virtue, or a tradition that teaches it
entries.summary: You cause the divine to manifest in the physical world, often with startling effects (see Miraculous Effects). *

entries.title: Transcendence
entries.requires: the Transcendence Virtue, or a tradition that teaches it
entries.summary: You can overcome the limitations of the physical world and thus bring about miraculous changes to your mind and body (see Miraculous Effects). *

entries.title: Understanding
entries.requires: the Understanding Virtue, or a tradition that teaches it
entries.summary: You receive holy visions that can provide guidance and information directly from the divine (see Miraculous Effects). *

entries.title: Holy Music
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability tied to the Holy Method of Meditation: the character sings a devotional song, rolling Presence + Music against an ease factor, and uses Presence to determine the effect; distractions require a Concentration roll.
quotes: You must sing a devotional song, rolling your Presence + Music vs. an ease factor based on the circumstances.

related.text: Instruments of God, Holy Methods and Traditions

entries.title: Dream Interpretation
entries.summary: Supernatural Ability used either as a Holy Method for activating powers or as direct divination from dreams, with a preparation ritual, hours of contemplation and an Intelligence roll against an Ease Factor based on an equivalent Hermetic spell.
quotes: He may then make an Intelligence + Dream Interpretation roll.
The Ease Factor is the level of the equivalent Momentary non-ritual Intellego Hermetic spell.

entries.title: Gematria
entries.summary: A Jewish form of the Meditation Holy Method: study a text, then use the lower of Gematria and the book's Quality in place of Meditation; it also enables Shinnui Shem.
quotes: At the end of this time, he uses the lower of either his Gematria score or the book's Quality in place of his Meditation when activating holy powers.

entries.title: Kabbalah
entries.summary: The Jewish form of the Invocation Holy Method, and the knowledge used to form and animate a golem.
quotes: Kabbalah is the Jewish form of the Invocation Divine Method and can be used in the same way.

entries.title: Merkavah
entries.summary: The Jewish form of the Purity Holy Method, also the study of the names and orders of angels, demons and other beings, used to learn True Names.
quotes: Merkavah is the Jewish form of the Purity Divine Method and can be used in the same way.

entries.title: Ceremony (Infernal group rituals)
entries.summary: Lets a group of infernalists add their Characteristic and Ability or Method scores to a focus character's total, with a leader or a group modifier based on their Ceremony scores.
quotes: Group Modifier: Total Ceremony scores – 13
which for Infernal ceremonies must always number 13 (12 participants and the focus character)

entries.title: Chthonic Magic
entries.summary: A Supernatural Ability that substitutes for Magic Theory when doing dark or sinister lab work and adds to the vis a magus may use if it is Infernal.
quotes: You can substitute this Ability for Magic Theory when he is performing dark or sinister magic in the lab

entries.title: Consumption
entries.requires: the Consumption Virtue, or a tradition that teaches it
entries.summary: Through dark rites the character can manipulate the energy of living things, channeling it through himself or another (see Chapter 10: The Maleficia). *

entries.title: Corruption
entries.summary: A Supernatural Ability for subverting others through ceremonial influence, written works and corrupted teaching; victims may resist with a Perception + Infernal Lore roll against the corrupter's total.
quotes: roll a die (stress or simple, depending on the situation) and add her Communication and Corruption scores
Perception + Infernal Lore roll against this total

entries.title: Debauchery
entries.summary: The Unholy Method of focusing will through a strenuous physical act, at the cost of a long-term Fatigue level or a Light Wound, using Stamina for the maleficium roll.
quotes: calls upon her Stamina for the maleficium roll

entries.title: Diablerie
entries.requires: the Diablerie Virtue, or a tradition that teaches it
entries.summary: The character can exert control over spirits, demons, and the Infernal realm (see Chapter 10: The Maleficia). *

entries.title: Effusion
entries.requires: the Effusion Virtue, or a tradition that teaches it
entries.summary: The character wields power over the physical world through strife and malice, changing the properties of inorganic materials and controlling powerful forces of nature (see Chapter 10: The Maleficia). *

entries.title: Incantation
entries.summary: The Unholy Method of invoking Infernal power through chanted or written blasphemy, adding Communication to the roll and costing a Confidence point.
quotes: requires that he spend a point of Confidence to call the effect into being

entries.title: Malediction
entries.requires: the Malediction Virtue, or a tradition that teaches it
entries.summary: The character knows how to punish his enemies with diabolical curses that hinder and even destroy them using the power of the Infernal. *

entries.title: Phantasm
entries.requires: the Phantasm Virtue, or a tradition that teaches it
entries.summary: The character can create and control demonic illusions that appear to be quite substantial. *

entries.title: Psychomachia
entries.requires: the Psychomachia Virtue, or a tradition that teaches it
entries.summary: The character can possess and distort the mind, causing people to see things that are not there, act on their base desires, and obey his commands. *

gated.title: Integrating other magic
gated.intro: Bringing the insights of other traditions into Hermetic theory.

entries.title: Hermetic Integration of Ancient Magic
entries.requires: A source of ancient magic from Ancient Magic
entries.summary: Overview of how a magus can fold a pre-Hermetic tradition into Hermetic theory without fully synthesizing it, possibly bending or breaking the limits of magic.
quotes: Hermetic magic is versatile enough to integrate many of the principles of these magics

entries.title: Historical Settings
entries.summary: Optional guidance for running a saga set in an earlier era when these traditions still have living practitioners, with the troupe filling in missing hedge-magic details.
quotes: You will need to fill in a few rule details

entries.title: Integration and Original Research
entries.requires: A source of ancient magic from Ancient Magic
entries.summary: Explains how integration compares with original research and that breakthrough points from both approaches can be added together toward a single Breakthrough.
quotes: breakthrough points from integration may be added to breakthrough points from original research

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages (original research)

entries.title: Integration of Hedge Magic
entries.requires: Hermetic magus researching a hedge tradition
entries.summary: Introduces how Hermetic magi, especially Bonisagus Seekers, study hedge traditions to extend Hermetic theory.

entries.title: The Breakthrough (integrating hedge magic)
entries.requires: Hermetic magus researching a hedge tradition
entries.summary: Any magus may attempt to integrate a hedge tradition by accumulating breakthrough points; there are Minor, Major and Hermetic Breakthroughs of increasing difficulty, whose exact requirements the storyguide should vary.
quotes: Typically requires around 30 breakthrough points
Typically requires around 45 breakthrough points
Typically requires around 60 breakthrough points

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages, original research

versions.title: The Breakthrough
versions.requires: A source of ancient magic from Ancient Magic
versions.summary: Any magus may try a Breakthrough by accumulating breakthrough points; Minor, Major and Hermetic Breakthroughs differ in scope and in the points they typically need, and each chapter gives its own requirement.
quotes: he must accumulate a number of breakthrough points determined by the type of Breakthrough he is attempting
(Typically requires around 30 breakthrough points.)
(Typically requires around 60 breakthrough points.)

entries.title: Insight (integrating hedge magic)
entries.requires: Hermetic magus researching a hedge tradition
entries.summary: A magus spends seasons studying texts, relics or teachers of a hedge tradition and rolls to gain an insight, which yields Lab Texts and a specified partially Hermetic effect; teachers can also assist.
quotes: make a stress roll of Intelligence + Magic Theory against an Ease Factor of 18
insight Lab Texts have a level equal to the typical number of breakthrough points needed for the type of Breakthrough in question
A teacher can provide a number of insights equal to his (Hedge Magic) Theory Ability, in each Breakthrough associated with his tradition.

entries.title: UnGifted Initiations
entries.requires: Hedge tradition that Initiates unGifted characters
entries.summary: Special rules for traditions that initiate unGifted characters: the Initiation must include an Ordeal, earlier Ordeals do not count, and the Initiate cannot act as his own Mystagogue.
quotes: Initiations that affect unGifted characters must include an Ordeal

entries.title: The Integration Process
entries.requires: Hermetic magus researching a hedge tradition
entries.summary: A five-step summary: find a source, investigate it for Insight, invent the specified spell or device while experimenting, keep researching to the threshold, then reap the consequences.
quotes: gain a number of breakthrough points equal to the magnitude of the spell or device

versions.title: The Integration Process
versions.requires: A source of ancient magic from Ancient Magic
versions.summary: Five-step outline for integration: find a source, study it for Insight, invent the fixed effect it inspires, keep gaining breakthrough points until the threshold is met, then face the consequences.
quotes: she gains a number of breakthrough points equal to the magnitude of the spell or device

entries.title: Hermetic Use of Hedge Theory
entries.requires: Hedge tradition lacking a Theory Ability
entries.summary: A Hermetic researcher or hedge wizard may invent a (Hedge Magic) Theory Ability as a Hermetic Breakthrough, converting the points to experience and then acting as his own source of insight.
quotes: This Breakthrough normally requires 60 breakthrough points, but the researcher reduces this amount by his greatest existing (Hedge Magic) Theory or Magic Theory Ability Score.

entries.title: Original Research and Ancient Magic
entries.requires: Hermetic magus researching a hedge tradition
entries.summary: Breakthrough points from integrating hedge traditions, original research and ancient traditions are interchangeable for reaching a Breakthrough.
quotes: breakthrough points from integration may be added to breakthrough points from original research to determine whether a Breakthrough has been achieved

related.text: Houses of Hermes: True Lineages, original research

entries.title: Integration by Hedge Wizard Researchers
entries.requires: Hedge wizard with a (Hedge Magic) Theory Score
entries.summary: Hedge wizards can do their own integration research once they have a Theory Ability, but need more breakthrough points than a Hermetic researcher and face disapproving peers.
quotes: a hedge researcher requires double the number of breakthrough points that an equivalent Hermetic researcher would require

entries.title: Hermetic Integration of Elementalist magic
entries.summary: Minor Breakthroughs convert Elementalist background Virtues into Hermetic ones; a Major Breakthrough lets a magus substitute a Hermetic Technique or Form for an adapted Elementalist Art.
quotes: a magus may substitute his score in an appropriate Hermetic Technique or Form for his score in the Elementalist Art

related.text: Hedge Magic: Integration of Hedge Magic

entries.title: New Perdo Corpus Guidelines (Energy Magic)
entries.summary: Guidelines for lengthening Short-Term Fatigue recovery, causing loss of Short-Term or Long-Term Fatigue, and preventing recovery by rest.
quotes: Level 5: Cause a target to lose a Short-Term Fatigue level.

entries.title: New Creo Corpus Guidelines (Energy Magic)
entries.summary: Guidelines for speeding Fatigue recovery and restoring Short-Term or Long-Term Fatigue levels; only Momentary Ritual effects truly restore, while other Durations cause the levels to return as Long-Term Fatigue loss.
quotes: Ritual spells formulated according to these guidelines with Momentary Duration truly restore Fatigue levels.
Level 15: Restore a lost Long-Term Fatigue level.

entries.title: Hermetic Integration of folk witch magic
entries.requires: Hermetic magus integrating folk witch magic
entries.summary: Introduces example breakthroughs (Subtle Opening, Energy Magic, Sense of the Mystic, Ritual Items) that can be researched from folk witch practices, left to the troupe to allow or adapt.
quotes: It's up to the troupe to decide if any of them are actually possible in your saga.

related.text: Hedge Magic: Integration of Hedge Magic

entries.title: Breakthrough: Subtle Opening
entries.requires: Hermetic magus integrating folk witch magic
entries.summary: A breakthrough that merges the folk witch Opening of the Gift into the Hermetic Opening of the Arts, so apprentices avoid the Arts penalty when learning Supernatural Abilities; the discoverer may write a Lab Text for it.
quotes: Suggested Breakthrough Points: 30
the apprentice gains the Minor Hermetic Virtue: Subtle Opening

entries.title: Subtle Opening: Integration Effects
entries.requires: Hermetic magus integrating folk witch magic
entries.summary: How Insights contribute to the Subtle Opening: Vim effects, or varying the technique when Opening an apprentice's Arts with an Extraordinary Results roll, with dangers to the apprentice's Gift.
quotes: the magus earns 5 breakthrough points

entries.title: Breakthrough: Energy Magic
entries.requires: Hermetic magus integrating folk witch magic
entries.summary: Folk witches are not bound by the Limit of Energy, so studying them can yield additional Creo Corpus and Perdo Corpus guidelines for Fatigue.
quotes: Suggested Breakthrough Points: 55

entries.title: Breakthrough: Sense of the Mystic
entries.requires: Hermetic magus integrating folk witch magic
entries.summary: Studying the folk witch Second Sight, which senses invisible creatures without penetrating their Magic Resistance, yields a new Hermetic Virtue improving Intellego sensing magic; any character with Second Sight can provide insight.
quotes: Suggested Breakthrough Points: 45

entries.title: Breakthrough: Ritual Items
entries.requires: Hermetic magus integrating folk witch magic
entries.summary: Integrating potion brewing could let magi make charged items that hold ritual effects, which is particularly powerful together with Energy Magic.
quotes: Suggested Breakthrough Points: 45

entries.title: Ritual Items (charged items with ritual effects)
entries.summary: Explains how charged items holding ritual effects work: each charge costs the vis the ritual would normally cost, with the usual seasonal vis limit and charge calculation.
quotes: Each charge requires the same number of pawns of vis that casting the effect normally would otherwise cost.

related.text: ArM5 p.133 Curse of the Unportended Plague

entries.title: Integration of Gruagach Magic
entries.requires: Hermetic Breakthrough: Integration of gruagach magic
entries.summary: Introduces three possible Integration paths by which Hermetic magi can research gruagach magic.

entries.title: Integration: Cailleach Magic
entries.requires: Hermetic Breakthrough: Integration of Cailleach Magic
entries.summary: Integration of the gruagach Cailleach Magic spontaneous casting ability into Hermetic theory: obstacles, suggested Breakthrough points, the resulting Virtue and its consequences.
quotes: Suggested Breakthrough Points: 45
The Virtue Cailleach Magic is identical to Diedne Magic, except that the character does not receive the Dark Secret Flaw, but suffers from the Hedge Wizard Flaw instead.

entries.title: Integration: Flexible Formulaic Magic
entries.requires: Hermetic Breakthrough: Integration of Flexible Formulaic Magic
entries.summary: Integration of gruagach flexible Formulaic casting into Hermetic theory as a new Spell Mastery Ability, with suggested Breakthrough points, optional related Breakthroughs and consequences.
quotes: Suggested Breakthrough Points: 30

A magus with Spell Mastery in Flexible Formulaic Magic is able to vary one parameter of a Formulaic spell (Range, Duration, Target, or size) as long as the final level of the spell is within one magnitude for every full five points of the magus' Mastery Score.

entries.title: Integration: Improved Voice Range
entries.requires: Hermetic Breakthrough: Integration of Improved Voice Range
entries.summary: Integration of the gruagach ability to affect unsensed targets within hearing, with suggested Breakthrough points, the resulting rule and a suggested extra magnitude.
quotes: Suggested Breakthrough Points: 60
It is suggested that the magnitude for Improved Voice spells be +3

entries.title: Hermetic Nightwalkers and Certamen Origins
entries.requires: Major Breakthrough (Nightwalker integrated into Hermetic theory)
entries.summary: An optional saga rule: certamen derives from nightwalking, and a Major Breakthrough could let Hermetic magi gain the Nightwalker Virtue with phantastica shaped by their highest Technique and Form pair, with consequences for House Tremere's Focus (Certamen).
quotes: Hermetic magi do not have a certamen score, just as nightwalkers do not have a Nightwalking score.

entries.title: Path of Seeming Spirit Travel
entries.summary: Optional research: a Minor or Major Breakthrough could replace the Station of Passing Through Seeming with a spirit-travel power resembling Nightwalker with a human phantasticum and no required spirit battles.
quotes: This is a Minor Breakthrough for a researcher who has mastered the Station of Passing Through Seeming, or a Major Breakthrough for one who has not done this.
